notes:
• Default device and My device are chosen in two menus: a category, science fiction or fantasy (or, for My device, the world's default), then a device or look from that category alone, instead of all eighteen in one list. Everyone's current choice stays as it is.
  • The Holoprojector's bright band no longer gives a panel a scroll bar as it runs past the bottom.
  • Clicking a scene in the sidebar's Scenes tab views it, instead of opening its configuration; Shift+click opens the configuration. A setting puts Foundry's way back.
  • A scene's preview lists who is on it in a section of its own, a name each, however many there are; the scene's lighting, vision and sound sit one to a line above it; and a long button, such as Hide from players, keeps its words inside it.
  • Everyone's volume, for the GM: a button under the Playlists tab's volume sliders asks each connected player's Foundry for their music, environment and interface volume, and lists them, with whether they have muted Foundry or their browser is holding sound back until they click.
  • The Playlists tab's Volume Controls and Currently Playing headers can be read on the Journal's, the Grove's and the Crystal core's pages.
  • The right-click editors (experience and level, hit points, hero points, an item's name and quantity) open over the panels, just under what was right-clicked, instead of inside its panel, where most devices cut them off and hid their Close button.
  • The projection offers to take a drop only for an item, or a folder of items. An actor dragged across the HUD on its way to the map, a scene, a journal, a macro, an effect on its own and the rest pass over it.

Full details in the release notes.
